summary: Build a child-friendly app called "My Health Buddy" with an "About the Creator" page and consistent copyright/disclaimer copy across the UI.

existing_features.title: Update the "About the Creator" page to display the exact user-provided child-voice text using the creator name "Gabriella Gayle" and include the bottom copyright line "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. All rights reserved." The typography must remain small, calm, and child-friendly.

Update the app-wide footer copyright line on every screen to read exactly: "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. My Health Buddy and the Luma character are original creations. All rights reserved." Keep the footer text small, calm, and child-friendly.

Ensure the footer includes an "About the Creator" link/button on every screen that navigates to the About the Creator page (if already on the About the Creator page, the link/button may be disabled or still present but must not break navigation).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add an "About the Creator" page with provided child-voice text and bottom copyright line
Add a footer link on every screen to the "About the Creator" page
Add a small footer on every screen with the provided global copyright/original creations statement
Add a short copyright/originality line inside the Safety or Privacy page
Ensure all added text is small, calm, and child-friendly in styling

Add (or ensure) the following short copyright/originality line appears inside the Privacy & Safety (or Safety) page content, styled small, calm, and child-friendly: "The Luma character, wording, and design of this app are original and protected."
